text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi

(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) (No. 2) 2020.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 dipinda

berhubung dengan negara "Indonesia", dengan memasukkan selepas butiran

"University Sumatera Utara" dan butir-butir yang berhubungan dengannya

butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

Name of Institution

granting qualification

Description of qualification

"Hasanuddin University (UNHAS) Sarjana Sains

(Recognised on 8 November 2011)".

Dibuat 7 April 2020

[KKM.R.600-1/1/26 Jld.3(25); PN(PU2)200/IV]

Dato' Sri Dr. Adham bin Baba

Menteri Kesihatan
P.U. (A) 119-120. 1634

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS ACT 1951

Registration of Pharmacists (Amendment of First Schedule)

(No. 2) Order 2020

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(3) of the Registration

of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 371], the Minister, after consulting the Board,

makes the following order:
